usage.finalMessage:
I added the `fee-preview <invoice>` command and listed it in `help` directly after `run-late-fees`; all 7 tests pass and the work is committed.
The preview uses the same fee rule as `run-late-fees`, which still charges 2% from the replaced decision DEC-B03, not the 1.5% in DEC-B08, the decision in force. So `BILL-31-R1` is only partially implemented.
I left the charged rate alone because changing it alters what customers pay and breaks an existing test. Finance needs to approve 1.5%; the open question is in `.work/report.json`.
